description: We are Tech Warriors from Rajshahi, participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge for the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" challenge. We aim to leverage Earth observation data and modern technology for sustainable agriculture. Looking for passionate members skilled in coding, AI/ML, data analysis, and design to join our team!
summary: AgroNexa is a farmer-centered agricultural decision-support platform developed by Team Tech Warriors for Humanity for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Designed for Bangladeshi farmers, AgroNexa combines NASA Earth observation data, local soil information, crop characteristics, and farmer-provided conditions to support informed crop selection and seasonal crop-rotation planning. By considering weather, soil, water availability, land conditions, and previous crops, the platform aims to help farmers explore more suitable agricultural options across Kharif-1, Kharif-2, and Rabi seasons. It uses NASA POWER, SMAP, and MODIS historical indicators with clear source attribution and data limitations. AgroNexa transforms complex environmental information into accessible, practical insights through a mobile-friendly interface with Bangla support, helping farmers make more informed and climate-aware farming decisions.
details:
AgroNexa is a farmer-centered agricultural decision-support platform developed for Bangladeshi farmers in response to NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: Field Shift — Adapting Farms with NASA Data.

How It Works: AgroNexa brings together NASA Earth observation data, local soil information, crop characteristics, and farmer-provided information to support informed agricultural decisions. Farmers can provide their location, land conditions, irrigation availability, previous crops, and farming priorities. The platform is designed to help explore suitable crop options and seasonal crop-rotation strategies across Bangladesh's Kharif-1, Kharif-2, and Rabi seasons.

Data and Technology: The project uses NASA POWER historical climate data, SMAP satellite-derived surface soil moisture information, and MODIS NDVI/EVI vegetation indicators. It also incorporates crop characteristics, provisional local soil information, and agricultural references from SRDI, BARC, DAE/BAMIS, BRRI, and SoilGrids. Data sources, limitations, and evidence status are considered to avoid presenting estimates as direct field measurements.

Benefits and Intended Impact: AgroNexa aims to make complex environmental and agricultural information easier to understand, help farmers explore more suitable crop choices, support seasonal planning, and encourage climate-aware farming decisions. Its mobile-first interface and Bangla language support are designed to improve accessibility for farmers in Bangladesh.

Creativity and Innovation: The innovative approach is combining space-based Earth observations with local agricultural knowledge, farmer priorities, crop characteristics, and seasonal rotation planning in one accessible platform. Rather than presenting unexplained AI-generated recommendations, the project emphasizes transparent information, data provenance, and decision-support logic.

Development Tools: The project development involved Google AI Studio, Gemini, AI-assisted coding, web technologies, structured JSON/CSV datasets, and digital design and multimedia tools.

Our long-term vision is to make space-based information more useful for farming communities and support more informed, resilient, and sustainable agriculture in Bangladesh.
